svg.text: Top1 genre locks the main pattern; variant family and protected texture change inside the same genre idea.
Each preview includes a reduced-density visible pcm_reversible_data texture field for visual checking.

svg.desc: Reversible Sound Form Engine. A 100-pass audio-fingerprint morphology search, Wikipedia-derived genre estimation, and a 30-pass structural self-debate choose one of thirty genre-specific sound forms. Different songs and variants therefore change the large structure, not only the line texture. Restoration PCM is added as a visible locked pcm_reversible_data internal texture on export.
